homework.title: Observation-only experiment at coffee shop
homework.description: Go to the coffee shop near your apartment tomorrow morning when it's busy. For 2-3 minutes, sit or stand with your phone out, pretending to scroll through emails. Observe the general flow of people—notice how they move, whether anyone looks up from their phone or conversation, and whether anyone's gaze lands on you. Do not interact with anyone. Afterward, jot down a few notes on what you actually observed.

homework.title: Thought record for the observation experience
homework.description: After completing the observation, write down the situation (coffee shop, time of day), the automatic thoughts you had before/during/after (e.g., 'People are going to notice me'), the emotions you felt (e.g., anxiety, relief), and what actually happened (e.g., 'No one looked at me'). Use a simple table or notes app.
